gaps: No mass fraction of titanium/invar/aluminium fittings printed for NASA erectable truss, JWST, Herschel, Planck or Hubble metering truss struts (not found/fetched).
No MPa lap-shear or push-out strength with stated bond length for CFRP tube-to-metal bonds found; only kN pull-to-failure (SMA memo, tube dimensions not printed) and a 5,000 psi design limit.
No node/connector mass for CFRP space frames found (property node_mass has zero rows).
No kN capacity found for a thin-walled long CFRP strut of 2.4 m class with its fittings; NASA Altair struts are 6.5 in OD class, 107 klb loads, far heavier than 750-tube frame struts.
Mass-fraction check from Messinger table (insert+ball over total) left to the card; not computed here.
